title: Status Pills in All Chats (taste prototype, opt-in): live chats in the New Tab's All Chats list end with a Running, Needs you, Done or Failed pill

steps.title: A chat so All Chats has a live row
New Tab: All Chats with the setting off (today's rows)
Turn on Status Pills in All Chats
New Tab: live chats now end with a status pill; idle and older chats show none
The pills stay as the list updates
